chunks.text: Today we will talk about Togo.
Togo is a small, colorful, and friendly country in West Africa.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where's Togo?
Togo is in West Africa.
It is next to Ghana, Benin, and Burkina Faso.
To the south, it touches the Atlantic Ocean.
Togo has beaches, hills, and forests.
What is the capital city of Togo?
The capital city is Lome.
Lome is on the coast by the sea.
It has markets, museums, offices, and beaches.
It is the largest city in Togo.
Other towns include Cara in the north, Sokode in the center, Atakpame near the mountains.
How many people live in Togo?
About 8.5 million people live in Togo.
Some live in cities, but many live in villages and rural areas.
Togo is a multicultural country with many ethnic groups.
What language do people speak in Togo?
The official language is French.
People also speak local languages like in the south, Kabia in the north, Mina, Tim, and others.
Many people speak two or three languages in daily life.
What is the weather like in Togo?
Togo has a tropical climate.
It is hot and humid near the coast.
It is drier in the north.
There are two rainy seasons and two dry seasons.
Most of the year is warm with lots of sun.
What does Togo look like?
Togo has long beaches on the coast, Green Hills in the center, Forests in savannas, mountains and rivers in the north.
It is a narrow country but full of natural beauty.
What animals live in Togo?
In Togo you can see Monkeys, antelopes and bats, Snakes, lizards, and frogs.
Cows, goats and chickens on farms, Birds, fish and insects.
Togo has national parks to protect wildlife.
What do people eat in Togo?
Togo leaves food is simple, flavorful and filling.
People eat maize, cassava and millet, Rice, yams and plantains, Fish, chicken and goat, Peanuts, tomatoes and spices.
Popular dishes, fufu, soft dough made from cassava or yams.
Pot, thick porridge made from maize flour.
Riz sauce, arachid, rice with peanut sauce.
Akpan, fermented maize with sugar.
Steamed corn cakes.
What do people drink in Togo?
People drink water and fruit juice, Tea and coffee.
Beesap, hibiscus flower drink.
Ginger juice.
Adults may drink palm wine or local beer.
In hot weather people drink a lot of water to stay cool.
What is life like in Togo?
Life in Togo is often traditional, busy and community based.
People enjoy spending time with family, Working in markets or on farms, Going to church or mosque, Dancing, drumming and storytelling, Helping neighbors and celebrating together.
Children often play football or run barefoot outside.
What are some holidays and traditions?
Independence Day, April 27th, Eid al -Fitr and Eid al -Adha.
Christmas and New Year.
Traditional festivals with music, masks and dances.
Yam Festival, a harvest celebration in many villages.
People wear bright clothes and music is a big part of every event.
Some fun facts about Togo.
Togo is one of the smallest countries in Africa.
The Togolese flag is green, yellow and red with a white star.
People often carry things on their heads.
Football is the most popular sport.
Togo means behind the river in the U language.
Now you know many things about Togo.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the beaches, music and food.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emile.
